data.name: Desperate Battler
data.description: Your experiences fighting against numerous foes that have already overwhelmed your allies, friends, and family have forced you to excel at fighting on your own. Gain +1 morale bonus on melee attack and damage when alone. Your experiences fighting against numerous foes that have already overwhelmed your allies, friends, and family have forced you to excel at fighting on your own. When no ally is within 10 ft. of you and you are not receving benefits from the aid another action, you gain a +1 morale bonus on melee attack and damage rolls.
